criterion.description: Id of the typed criterion in criteria[] that holds your own checkpoint for this author expectation. Write it only when the expectation node carries no literal declaration. The criterion's quote, operator and literal (or count, or relation) must equal this assertion's.

precondition_source.description: 前置步骤来源（可选）：若本步是为使作者命令或触发动作生效而从手册或示例补齐的前提步骤（含对应 cleanup:true 逆清理）且未在重组 sources.states 列出，填锁定 knowledge/ 手册条文或示例的引用及逐字原文，供 Hub 核对引文并列入保真豁免

author_step_refs.description: 本步实现的作者步骤编号列表（本步不实现作者步骤时省略）：写本条重组记录里作者步骤的 id（items/<n>.json 的 atoms 里 kind 为 action 的 id，如 ["a2"] 或 ["a2", "a3"]），不是序号；每条作者动作原句至少要有一步写它的编号，没有的 check-plan 拒绝并点名；写了不存在的编号会在生成保真简报时被点名拒绝；不改变命令语义

description.description: 这一步做什么的一句话，写进工作簿 D 列，运行报告按它显示步骤

op.description: Use not_found to check absence; omit it to retain the existing found check

basis.description: 显式声明 model_judgment 时 text 是模型选择的设备可观察检查文字；不写时维持引文片段规则

rationale.description: model_judgment 的非空理由；声明是模型判断，Hub 不断言其语义正确

command_identities.description: 可选的模型身份声明；通常省略。Hub 从 steps 的完整设备命令行按锁定树解析 CommandIdentity，不要求模型填写类型值。若主动声明，commands_known 逐项核结构并与 Hub 解析身份集合完全比对，不一致记违规；不得用声明代替解析

output.description: The id of the observation block this row explains: a blocks[].id of a block that returns device text (OBSERVE_ASSERT, OBSERVE_ONLY, CAPTURE, EXPECT_FROM, or a STEP that declares output). It is never a register name (the register of a CAPTURE or STEP is only the name its text is saved under), never the name of a selected cell and never a device name.

kind.description: Who answers: device (a frozen environment seat), fixture (an earlier step block of this plan), bed_service (a service declared in the frozen environment inventory) or undetermined (not known yet; also write missing and next_action).

ref.description: Identifies the answerer, by kind. device: one frozen runtime-profile device identity, exactly one of profile.seats[].device (not an executor object name and not a block id). fixture: the id of an earlier step block of this plan that provides the answer. bed_service: the host of a service of the frozen environment inventory (services[].host). undetermined: any non-empty text.

quote.description: Verbatim source text that grounds the answerer; copy reference and text from the source.

missing.description: Only for kind=undetermined: the fact that is missing.

next_action.description: Only for kind=undetermined: the next step that would settle it.

responders.description: Who answers the request a host-command observation sends. One row per host observation block; every row's output must be the id of an observation block of this plan.

criteria.description: Checkpoints you chose yourself for author expectations that carry no literal declaration (the author wrote a sentence, not the text to look for). Each entry is a model judgment, status 未确认: the Hub only checks that quote is the author's expectation word for word, that literal is a single line and that the entry equals its assertion; no independent review is needed and none is started, and the device run decides whether the checkpoint holds. quote: the author's expectation, copied verbatim from the original case. literal (or count, or relation): text the device output can contain. rationale: why you chose it. scope_root: the locked root of the command tree. A criteria_review input is read only when one is bound; leave it unbound.
